extract_notes: skip: lab-scale bioremediation/microbial remediation experiment (TC-degrading bacterial consortium applied to soil in containers in incubators). Only pollutant measured is tetracycline (TC) which is not in target antibiotic list (SMZ/SDZ/ENRO/CTC/OTC). Initial TC concentrations (~55 mg/kg sample B, ~35 mg/kg sample Y) are approximate values from supplementary Table S1, not sample-level data from a main table. No target OP (PAH/PCB/DDT/HCH/PBDE/PHC/PAE/OCP) or target antibiotic data in this paper.
